errata.old_text: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand here, ignoring its cost.
errata.new_text: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand, ignoring its cost. If it’s a unit, play it here.

errata.old_text: [1][C], [E]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may play a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
errata.new_text: [1][C], [E]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

errata.old_text:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Each opponent reveals the top card of their Main Deck. Choose one and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
errata.new_text:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Each opponent reveals the top card of their Main Deck. Choose one and banish it, then play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

errata.old_text: As you play me, you may pay [C] as an additional cost. If you do, draw 1.
errata.new_text:
You may pay [C] as an additional cost to play me.

When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, draw 1.

errata.old_text:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Choose a friendly unit. Increase its Might until it equals the Might of another friendly unit.
errata.new_text:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Choose a friendly unit. This turn, increase its Might to the Might of another friendly unit.

errata.old_text: At the end of your turn, ready 2 runes.
errata.new_text: At the end of your turn, ready up to 2 runes.

errata.old_text: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.
errata.new_text: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit and banish it. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.

errata.old_text:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If this kills it, draw 1.
errata.new_text:
Action (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If this kills it, do this: draw 1.

errata.old_text: Move an enemy unit. Then choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
errata.new_text: Move an enemy unit. Then do this: Choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

errata.old_text: When I attack, give me +2 [M] if there is a ready enemy unit here.
errata.new_text: When I attack, give me +2 [M] this turn if there is a ready enemy unit here.

errata.old_text:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Choose a friendly unit. The next time it dies this turn, recall it exhausted instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)
errata.new_text:
[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

errata.old_text:
[Vision] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

When you recycle one or more cards, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 [M] buff. Runes aren't cards.)
errata.new_text:
[Vision] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

When you recycle one or more cards to your Main Deck, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 [M] buff. Runes aren't cards.)

errata.old_text: When you play me, buff two other friendly units. (Each one that doesn't have a buff gets a +1 [M] buff.)
errata.new_text: When you play me, buff up to two other friendly units. (Each one that doesn't have a buff gets a +1 [M] buff.)

errata.old_text:
[Ganking] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

When you look at cards from the top of your deck (and don't draw them) and see me, you may play me for [A].
errata.new_text:
[Ganking] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

As you look at or reveal me from the top of your deck, you may banish me. If you do, you may play me for [A].

errata.old_text: [E]: Return another friendly gear, unit, or [Hidden] card to its owner's hand.
errata.new_text: [E]: Return another friendly gear, unit, or facedown card to its owner's hand.

errata.old_text:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Banish a friendly unit, then play it to base, ignoring its cost.
errata.new_text:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)

Banish a friendly unit, then its owner plays it to their base, ignoring its cost.

errata.old_text: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, chooses one, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs. (They must still pay Power costs.)
errata.new_text: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, banishes one of them, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs. (They must still pay Power costs.)

errata.new_text: [E]: The next spell you play this turn deals 1 Bonus Damage. (Each instance of damage the spell deals is increased by 1.)

errata.new_text:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
